doc: Intro story cutscene timeline. World coords are the 640x360 design frame (y down); layers are drawn in order. Each layer: kind, par (parallax factor vs the camera), optional t0/t1 visibility window, and 'keys' = per-property keyframes [[t, value], ...] (shot-local seconds). Designer art: drop assets/sprites/cutscene_<layer id>.png (or cutscene_<shot id>_<layer id>.png) to replace an 'image' layer's sprite.

captions.text: A quiet morning in the nest.
Something crawled out of the fire.
